Package org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

Data models and database entities for procedure configuration, global configuration, computation configuration, constants and procedure execution preferences.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IterableEntity
    Interface for an entities that can change values over procedure iterations (for example, Filter, ReferenceBeam) There is also a IndexIteratableEntity which iterates over the loop index.
